_comment: Ship-time SessionStart hook for pos-v2. On first run in a fresh clone, first-run.sh creates the venv, installs dependencies, authors settings.json stanzas, substitutes plists, and brings services up — then self-retires by rewriting this file to invoke the sealed supervisor path (pos_session_start.py with the venv Python) directly and deleting itself. See hands-off-lifecycle/README.md for the lifecycle. See docs/rebuild/FUTURE_IDEAS.md for the self-retire convention.
